current_difficulty_reason: Allowing Mellit and the prior Springer cohomology relation leaves a new geometric obligation before the final matrix inversion applies. The full construction is retained, so the selected singular intersection-cohomology formula is not admitted merely for formal symmetric-function bookkeeping.
